name: worklog
description: Automatically captures Claude Code work sessions and summarizes them into a daily worklog.

notes_path.title: Notes directory
notes_path.description: Where to write the generated daily worklog (.md) files. Leave empty to use the plugin's default data directory. Set this to an Obsidian vault path to keep notes there instead.

archive_after_days.title: Archive raw logs after (days)
archive_after_days.description: Raw session logs older than this are gzip-compressed in place. Nothing is ever deleted. Default: 180.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: If set, summarization runs in isolated mode (--bare) using this key instead of your Claude Code subscription session. Leave empty to use your existing login.

summary_model.title: Summary model (optional)
summary_model.description: Model to use when generating summaries. Leave empty to use your default model.
